question.stem: Overfishing is causing the decline of fish populations, such as Eastern Atlantic bluefin tuna in the Mediterranean. Eastern Atlantic bluefin tuna are caught faster than they can reproduce. Which statement describes the most likely effect that overfishing will have on this ecosystem?

options.label: G
options.text: Overfishing decreases the stability of the ecosystem by disrupting food chains.

options.label: H
options.text: Overfishing has no effect on ecosystem’s stability because it affects one species out of many.

options.label: J
options.text: Overfishing increases ecosystem stability by allowing prey populations to overproduce.
